args.title: Fix email validation to handle trailing spaces
args.body:
File: src/api/errors.ts

Currently, the login fails with a "validation failed" error when an email address with a trailing space is submitted. This change will modify the email validation logic to trim any trailing spaces before processing, ensuring users can log in without issues.
